mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 45 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a Full Moon. The ISS is passing overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study. They are looking for community feedback on initial design concepts for the area between Dodgeville and Fitchburg. You can attend in person at Mount Horeb High School on November 18 or virtually on November 19.

We have a busy couple of days for local fun. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, enjoy live music or trivia at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29.

In a noteworthy call from the past week, officers were dispatched early in the morning on October 25 to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. They found a 40-year-old Verona man unresponsive in his vehicle, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
If you are looking for a treat, today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The Culver's of Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM.
